context: Q3 2026: three consecutive deficit months while prices fell stepwise; end-Sep spot ~40% below the mid-May high - deficit/price divergence is the core trader-influence watch item.
SMM inventory methodology change added ~175,000 t to measured Chinese stockpiles - treat inventory levels and cross-change history with care.
Inventory falling: SMM stock 122,644 mt (week to Nov 13); Mysteel expects Q4 destocking above 50,000 t.

GFEX receipts: -17,378 t since early September, but +2,040 t on Nov 9 then +50 t on Nov 10 - watch whether the drawdown has stalled; a sustained build while spot rebounds is a bearish physical signal.
Nov 17 session: LC2701 bottomed 86,740, closed 93,180 on reduced OI (short covering) while spot fell - classic paper/physical divergence.
SGX Nov-26 slid 15.68 to 14.54 USD/kg (Oct 9 to Nov 18); regional premium over China ex-VAT remains ~19%.
Demand mix shifting from NEVs to grid/energy-storage LFP; EU to cap Chinese EV imports at 350,000 units/year from next year.
Supply restarts: Bald Hill, Finniss; Rio Tinto spending $1.4bn on Fenix 1B and Sal de Vida expansion.
